description: One line of checks/checks.jsonl: the result of one named check on one card version

check.description: Named for what it proves. There is no check called verified.

result.description: passed, failed (card not citable if located or zone_valid), flagged (goes to review), not_run

label.description: For supported only: what the judge said

method.description: How: exact, normalised, rule, local_two_pass, claude_adjudicated, ...

detail.description: Short factual detail (page, offsets, which models)

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 of the quote plus page text at check time; a changed page makes the result stale

title: check
